tokens.name: almanac
tokens.usage: Brand ground, 55% of every composition. Raw value: use `bg` in UI.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Brand secondary ground for grouped panels. Raw value: use `surface` in UI.

tokens.name: sounding
tokens.usage: Brand ink, 30% of every composition. Raw value: use `ink` or `surface` (dark) in UI.

tokens.name: sounding-deep
tokens.usage: Deepest navy: device chrome, night-watch ground. Raw value: use `bg` (dark) in UI.

tokens.name: fog
tokens.usage: Rules and quiet marks on almanac (1.79:1, never text there). Muted text on navy grounds (7.73:1 on sounding).

tokens.name: signal-red
tokens.usage: The brand's Signal. Means now and slack, nothing else. 5% of a composition at most.

tokens.name: signal-rose
tokens.usage: Signal lifted for navy grounds, taken from the board's ticker. Raw value: use `signal` in UI.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and screen background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Grouped panels, list sections, sheets on `bg`.

tokens.name: surface-field
tokens.usage: Inputs and wells set into `surface`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and icons on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-field`. Light 13.81:1 on bg, 12.26:1 on surface. Dark 15.27:1 on bg, 13.81:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: units, timestamps, captions on `bg` and `surface`. Light 5.61:1 / 4.98:1. Dark 8.54:1 / 7.73:1.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: table row rules, dividers. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control boundaries (fields, outline buttons, chips). Light 3.57:1 on bg, 3.17:1 on surface. Dark 4.00:1 on bg, 3.61:1 on surface.

tokens.name: water
tokens.usage: Area fill under the tide curve. Decorative only.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Now marker, next-slack row, slack countdown text on `bg` and `surface`. Light 5.08:1 on bg, 4.52:1 on surface. Dark 6.62:1 on bg, 5.98:1 on surface.

tokens.name: signal-fill
tokens.usage: Filled Slack chip and the now dot. Always carries `on-signal` text.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `signal-fill`, 5.08:1.

tokens.name: fill-strong
tokens.usage: Primary button, selected segment, spring-tide chip.

tokens.name: on-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `fill-strong`, 13.81:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid, 2px offset. 13.81:1 or better on every ground.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark, always lowercase. Splash and About only.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Station name at the top of a screen. One per screen.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: High water 06:42. Plenty of time for coffee.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Heights are relative to chart datum.
styles.usage: Default running text. 17px, the iOS base size.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary text, helper text under fields.

styles.name: readout-xl
styles.usage: The next-slack time. One per screen.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Every number in tables, chips and rows. Tabular figures always.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase field labels above a readout. At most one per group.

spacing.note: 4px base. The brand board's 14px gutter is a print-board value; the app uses the 4px steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; label to readout.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in the tide table; field icon gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter (plus safe-area inset); card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Field and button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between groups on a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of screen to station title.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Print-like objects: the year tag, the booklet.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Panels and cards. The brand's one panel radius.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Fields, buttons, sheets' inner wells.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom-sheet top corners; device-scale containers.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, segmented control, the inline wave pill.

shadow.note: Depth, not lift. Each step is the water getting deeper under the object.

tokens.name: depth-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards on `bg`.

tokens.name: depth-2
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the search overlay.

tokens.name: depth-3
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs only.

duration.note: Named for water. Under prefers-reduced-motion every duration is 0ms except `dur-ripple`, which stays for opacity-only feedback.

tokens.name: dur-ripple
tokens.usage: Press feedback, focus ring, colour changes.

tokens.name: dur-swell
tokens.usage: Chip and segment state changes, row highlight.

tokens.name: dur-surge
tokens.usage: Sheets opening, chip lift. The board's chip transition.

tokens.name: dur-current
tokens.usage: Horizontal paging between days. The board's carousel.

tokens.name: dur-tide
tokens.usage: Tide curve drawing in, once per station load.

tokens.name: dur-slack
tokens.usage: One breath of the now dot at slack water. The only ambient loop.

tokens.name: dur-ticker
tokens.usage: One lap of the station ticker.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Entrances and responses: fast in, long settle. The brand board's curve.

tokens.name: ease-tide
tokens.usage: Sine in-out. State to state, loops, the curve draw. Slow at both turns, like the tide.

tokens.name: ease-ebb
tokens.usage: Exits only. Gathers speed as it leaves.

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: The ticker and scroll-linked progress only.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for every control, even when the visible shape is smaller.

tokens.name: size-chip
tokens.usage: Visible chip height. Pad the hit area to `size-touch`.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Buttons and segmented control.

tokens.name: size-field
tokens.usage: Station search field.

tokens.name: size-tabbar
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar, plus the bottom safe-area inset.
